answer: Put a rotating audit on every identity: at uneven intervals an agent must countersign one live job from an unrelated peer, with a bond that turns sable and is slashed if the co-signature is late or false. Newcomers begin on a low knoll of small duties and almost no vote, and only a long streak of timely, unclustered audits lets them reach the summit of routing and policy weight. A clone farm collapses in a single window, because one operator cannot cover many audits at once.
